Plan review: Add `subtract(a, b)` to calc.js + test file · ~/.commandcode/plans/add-subtract-to-calc.md · v1
Review the plan like a PR — type on any line to comment, enter pins it under the line.

   1   # Add `subtract(a, b)` to calc.js + test file
   ┃  ● Also cover a divide(a, b) helper here.
   2
   3   ## Context
   4   - `calc.js` is a small ESM module exporting `add(a, b)` and `mul(a, b)`. No
       `package.json`, no test framework, no dependencies.
   5   - Because `calc.js` uses `export`, tests will use Node's built-in test runner
       and import via ESM.
   6   - Decision (confirmed): use `node:test` + a `calc.test.mjs` file next to the
       source — zero new dependencies, no `package.json` required.
   7
   8   ## Changes
   9
  10   ### 1. `/private/tmp/ccplan-probe/sample-repo/calc.js`
  11   Append a `subtract` function matching the existing style (named export, two
       params, single return, no semicolon style already used):
  12
  13   ```js
  14   export function subtract(a, b) {
  15     return a - b;
  16   }
  17   ```
  18
  19   Place it after `mul` to keep exports top-to-bottom in a predictable order.
  20
  21   ### 2. `/private/tmp/ccplan-probe/sample-repo/calc.test.mjs` (new)
  22   Create a short test file using `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`:
  23
  24   - `import { test } from 'node:test'`
  25   - `import assert from 'node:assert/strict'`
  26   - `import { add, mul, subtract } from './calc.js'` (importing `./calc.js` from
       `.mjs` works since the extension is explicit and the file is ESM)
  27
  28   Tests to include (keep it short):
  29   - `subtract(5, 3) === 2` (positive result)
  30   - `subtract(3, 5) === -2` (negative result)
  31   - `subtract(0, 0) === 0` (identity/zero case)
  32   - One existing-function sanity test, e.g. `add(2, 3) === 5`, to confirm the
       import path works.
  33
  34   ## Files
  35   | File | Action |
  36   | --- | --- |
  37   | `calc.js` | Add `subtract` export |
  38   | `calc.test.mjs` | New test file (Node built-in runner) |
  39
  40   ## Verification
  41   Run from the repo root:
  42
  43   ```sh
  44   node --test calc.test.mjs
  45   ```
  46
  47   Expected: all `subtract` assertions pass (plus the `add` sanity test), exit code
       0. Alternatively `node --test` with the file beside the source will discover
       `*.test.mjs` automatically.
  48
  49   ## Notes / assumptions
  50   - No `package.json` is created, so no `npm test` script is added; tests are run
       directly with `node --test`.
  51   - README is not updated (it describes the repo only as a TUI probe); can add a
       usage line later if desired.
  52
